results.title: Evaluation of innovations and strategies for organic farming
results.content: Assessment of the importance of innovations/innovative processes for the development of organic arable farming; participants with occupation or interest in arable farming, number of responses: N = 172. Assessment of the importance of innovations/innovative processes for the development of organic dairy farming; participants with occupation or interest in dairy; number of responses: N = 79. CFs rated higher yields as significantly more important than OFAs, possibly reflecting a stronger economic orientation among CFs (Leduc et al.2023 Farmers’ perceived values in conventional and organic farming: a comparison between French, Irish and Swedish farmers using the means-end chain approach. A different survey location may reveal even greater differences in the evaluation of innovations and strategies between organic and CFs. Owing to the low number of participants in some stakeholder groups, especially in the evaluation of innovations for organic dairy farming, this study should be considered exploratory; further research could be carried out to verify the results.
